headline: Ikigai Law, GameChanger Law Advisors, Khaitan & Co act on Venomics AI pre-seed fundraise
sum: Venomics AI Private Limited has raised $2.7 million from a pre-seed fundraise led by Speciale Invest and South Park Commons, with participation from Operators Studio. Ikigai Law advised Venomics AI on this fundraise.
detail: Venomics AI Private Limited has raised $2.7 million from a pre-seed fundraise led by Speciale Invest and South Park Commons, with participation from Operators Studio. Ikigai Law advised Venomics AI on this fundraise. GameChanger Law Advisors advised lead investor Speciale Invest on this fundraise. The transaction was led by Samheeta Rao (Senior Partner).
